text: JT, et al. Population pharmacokinetics of amlodipine in hypertensive children and adolescents. J Clin Pharmacol 2006; 46: 905–16. Administration in hepatic impairment. The clearance of amlodipine is reduced in patients with hepatic impairment and lower doses should be considered; an initial dose of 2.5 mg once daily has been recommended.
